subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should the lineage stack land while legacy remains the default and lineage authority stays gated despite unresolved day-level variance?
rationale: The implementation and proof are credible, but accepting a new accounting authority path and defining when it may replace established totals are compatibility choices that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Land gated shadow stack
options.body: Merge the prerequisites and this slice with legacy authority, opaque authorization, family containment, and rollback preserved.

options.title: Wait for stronger parity
options.body: Hold the stack until more finalized daily corpora demonstrate acceptable day-level accuracy and repeat-scan stability.

options.title: Retain current containment only
options.body: Decline the lineage architecture and continue using the current-main file-local containment while pursuing a narrower alternative.

recommendation.title: Land gated shadow stack
recommendation.body: Merge the prerequisites and this slice with legacy authority, opaque authorization, family containment, and rollback preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this the best available owner for the compatibility and architecture acceptance decision.
